Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter, so you can open a game and start playing.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All the games run instantly in your browser, with no download and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, for many games. Games made for touch are collected in the Mobile category, and games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn the phone sideways. A few older games need a keyboard and mouse, and they say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site is family-friendly only, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Yes, but only in your own browser. Your recently played games, favourites, light or dark choice and the progress of most games stay on your device and never leave it. If you clear your browser data or play in private mode, they are lost.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it does not start, tell us by email at contact@ilovewebgames.com and name the game, so we can look into it.
Where do the games come from?

There are 6 games made by our own studio, Door 404, games licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and 53 games sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and an accepted game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can for the games made by Door 404. Each of them has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so they cannot be embedded this way.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
